// schema_version: REQUIRED. Bump when removing/renaming fields. Forward-compatible additions don't bump.
// servo_min_us: REQUIRED. Per-servo minimum pulse width (mechanical limit). Order: S0=Base, S1=Upper, S2=Last, S3=Joint1, S4=Joint2, S5=Gripper.
// servo_max_us: REQUIRED. Per-servo maximum pulse width (mechanical limit). Same channel order.
// servo_bias_us: OPTIONAL. Per-servo gravity-sag compensation, signed us. Added to the smoothed pulse width before clamping. Default 0. Range +/- 100 us.
// smooth_velocity_us_per_s: OPTIONAL. Per-servo trapezoidal max velocity. Default 2000 us/s.
// smooth_accel_us_per_s2: OPTIONAL. Per-servo trapezoidal max acceleration. Default 8000 us/s^2.
// smooth_deadband_us: OPTIONAL. Per-servo hold-pose deadband. 0 = disabled. Default 10 us. See JITTER_MITIGATION.md.
// interp_conf_floor_pct: OPTIONAL. SVM probability below which 'rest' weight is 1.0. Default 40.
// interp_conf_ceil_pct: OPTIONAL. SVM probability above which gesture weight is 1.0. Default 85.
// hysteresis_votes: OPTIONAL. Number of consecutive identical predictions required to commit a gesture transition. Default 3.
// grip_open_us: OPTIONAL. Gripper pulse width for open jaws. Default 1700.
// grip_touch_us: OPTIONAL. Gripper pulse width for jaws just touching object. Default 1200.
// grip_firm_us: OPTIONAL. Gripper pulse width for firm hold (deepest safe close, NEVER past mechanical min). Default 1100.
// grip_stall_recover_ms: OPTIONAL. Time to wait before backing off gripper if commanded position has been at servo_min for this duration. Default 2000.
// gesture_velocity: OPTIONAL (v2.3.5). Per-gesture per-servo velocity in us/s, signed. Consumed by cpcu_dsp.py only — the C parser ignores this field. When a row is present and any rate is non-zero, that gesture switches from freeze-mode (hold a fixed pose) to velocity-mode (target += rate * dt * confidence_scale). Range +/- 5000 us/s. Class names must match model.classes_; unknown names are warned and dropped. See VELOCITY_MODE.md.

gesture_velocity.// rest: rest stays freeze (no integration). Targets snap toward neutral.
gesture_velocity.// biceps_flex: Close the elbow joint over time. Hold gesture longer = elbow closes deeper.
gesture_velocity.// hand_flex: Close the hand. All four hand joints move together.
gesture_velocity.// hand_open: Open the hand. Negative rates reverse direction.
